question_text: Explain how a remote-access VPN can let an authenticated worker reach internal project files while protecting traffic over the internet.
adaptation_rationale: Original application rewritten to be self-contained; assessed reasoning retained within cited 2027 scope.
solution: Worker authenticates to the organization’s VPN end point.; VPN establishes a tunnel between the device and end point.; Encryption protects the contents crossing the untrusted internet.; Authorized internal routing/resource permissions let the worker reach the project-file service.
